sandbox_image.description: The pause container image used for sandbox containers in CRI.

max_container_log_line_size.description: Maximum size (in bytes) of a single log line from a container. Longer lines are truncated.

systemd_cgroup.description: If true, use systemd cgroup driver instead of cgroupfs for containers.

enable_streaming.description: Enable streaming server for exec/attach operations.

streaming_server_address.description: Bind address for the streaming server (exec/attach).

enable_tls_streaming.description: Enable TLS encryption for the streaming server. Requires cert/key/ca paths below if true.

stream_server_tls_cert.description: Path to the TLS certificate for streaming server (used only if TLS is enabled).

stream_server_tls_key.description: Path to the TLS private key for streaming server (used only if TLS is enabled).

stream_server_tls_ca.description: Path to the TLS CA certificate for streaming server (used only if TLS is enabled).

snapshotter.description: Name of the snapshotter plugin (e.g., overlayfs, native).

default_runtime_name.description: Name of the default runtime to use (must match one in runtimes).

runtimes.description: List of container runtimes to register. Each object defines a named runtime with its type and options.

name.description: Runtime name (used as key; must be unique).

engine.description: Optional: container runtime engine name (e.g., crun).

privileged_without_host_devices.description: If true, restrict host devices in privileged containers.

runtime_root.description: Optional: root directory for runtime state.

options.description: Runtime-specific options (key-value pairs passed to the runtime).

registry_mirrors.description: List of registry mirror configurations to override default Docker Hub pull paths.

registry_config_path.description: Path to registry TLS certificates and auth configs (overrides built-in defaults if non-empty).

registry_configs.description: List of registry authentication configs (e.g., for private registries).

auth_password.description: Password for registry auth (plaintext in config—secure only if file permissions are protected).

enable_image_decryption.description: Enable support for decrypting encrypted images (e.g., with gRPC key provider). Requires x509 cert/key paths below if true.

tls_cert_file.description: Path to TLS cert file for image decryption streaming (if enabled).

tls_key_file.description: Path to TLS key file for image decryption streaming (if enabled).

discard_unpacked_layers.description: If true, discard unpacked layers after successful container creation to save disk space.

metrics_address.description: Address (host:port) for metrics endpoint (empty string disables metrics server).

plugins_opt_path.description: Path for plugin-specific state and data (e.g., certificates).
